constraints: Generally called within a method installed via ON ERR CALL, to inspect the error raised by the last SOAP request.
Returns an empty string when no information is available, particularly when the last SOAP request did not generate any errors.

overloadMerges.note: Restored sentinelValues on infoType from the documented 'Web Service ...' info constants (values 0-3); autoparse leaves infoType as a plain Integer with no enum meaning.

params.name: infoType
params.description: Type of information to retrieve about the last SOAP error

sentinelValues.meaning: Web Service error code: main 4D error code (also returned in the Error system variable); one of 9910 (Soap fault), 9911 (Parser fault), 9912 (HTTP fault), 9913 (Network fault), 9914 (Internal fault)
Web Service detailed message: a message describing the error, whose content depends on the main error code
Web Service HTTP status code: HTTP error code, used when the main error is 9912 (HTTP fault)

Web Service fault actor: SOAP-protocol-reported cause of the error, used when the main error is 9910 (Soap fault) -- e.g. Version Mismatch, Must Understand, Sender Fault, Receiver Fault, Encoding Unknown

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns, as Text, the piece of information selected by infoType about the error generated during the last SOAP request sent via WEB SERVICE CALL.
